ablation.name: local_t24_ll_std_only
ablation.notes: T24: Plan F Std-Only LL AdaIN. Plan E (mean-only) 失败: LPIPS对mean偏移极敏感,CLIP不受益. Plan F 互补: 仅迁移LL std(对比度/纹理),保留mean(亮度). ll_K_matched = (ll_K-pred_mean)/pred_std*target_std + pred_mean. 假设: CLIP正向(纹理迁移),LPIPS中性(亮度保留). 目标: clip>0.7213 AND lpips<0.2868 (dual beat T11).
